Virtually all feminine nouns end in the same vowel, -a. The vocative of nouns is the only remaining case in the Macedonian language and is used to address a person directly. For feminine nouns, the most common final vowel ending in the vocative is -o (душо, sweetheart vocative; жено, wife vocative). There is no vocative case in neuter nouns. The role of the vocative in the Macedonian language is only facultative, and there is a general tendency of vocative loss. This is because its use is considered impolite and dialectal.
